Reviewed source" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1ebfb;strokeColor=#9b7ac3;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="125" width="280" height="95" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="skills" value="Expose skill metadata" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2ff;strokeColor=#6b96cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="420" y="20" width="310" height="85" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="extensions" value="Register agent / hook" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff3db;strokeColor=#c59b4f;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="420" y="130" width="310" height="85" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="mcp" value="MCP when present" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f6fa;strokeColor=#b5c1cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=26;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="420" y="240" width="310" height="85" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="session" value="Host session

svg.title: The host exposes the supported components of an enabled plugin
svg.desc: After review, a host processes enabled plugin components according to its own support and policy. It can expose skill metadata, register optional host extensions, and configure MCP servers when present. An enabled package is not proof of skill invocation or successful execution.
